leads.label: Leads
leads.plain: People who shared a phone number so we can follow up. Not yet scored.

mqls.label: MQLs
mqls.plain: Marketing-qualified leads: scored HOT or WARM — worth a counsellor's time soon.

bookings.label: Bookings
bookings.plain: Counselling calls that were scheduled on the calendar.

spend.label: Ad spend
spend.plain: Money spent on Meta/Google ads. Wired in the next ads sync — placeholder for now.

diag_start.label: Diagnostic starts
diag_start.plain: How many people began the Pathway Diagnostic questionnaire.

diag_complete.label: Diagnostic completes
diag_complete.plain: How many people finished every question and saw a result.

diag_dropoff.label: Question drop-off
diag_dropoff.plain: Where people stop answering. A tall early bar means the question may be confusing.

conversion.label: Conversion %
conversion.plain: Share of people who moved from the previous step to this one.

band_hot.label: HOT
band_hot.plain: Highest-priority leads. A counsellor should contact them within 4 business hours.

band_warm.label: WARM
band_warm.plain: Good-fit leads who are not as urgent as HOT — still worth a personal follow-up.

band_nurture.label: NURTURE
band_nurture.plain: Not ready yet. They get helpful follow-up messages, not an immediate sales push.

band_dq.label: DISQUALIFIED
band_dq.plain: Not a fit right now. We stop selling and may send a short honest explanation.

hot_sla.label: HOT SLA timer
hot_sla.plain: Countdown of the 4 business-hour window to first counsellor contact for HOT leads.

dq_reasons.label: DQ reasons
dq_reasons.plain: Why leads were marked not-a-fit — so we can fix ads or the Diagnostic.

llm_cost.label: AI usage cost
llm_cost.plain: What we spent on language-model calls today/this month, toward the €300 infra envelope.

envelope.label: €300 envelope
envelope.plain: Monthly infrastructure budget for hosting and AI — not including ad spend.

attended.label: Attended
attended.plain: Counselling call that actually happened (logged by a counsellor).

application.label: Application
application.plain: Candidate started a formal application — logged by a counsellor for now.

paid.label: Paid
paid.plain: Candidate paid — logged by a counsellor until platform billing sync exists.

pathway.label: Pathway
pathway.plain: Which career track the person is exploring (for example nursing professional or Ausbildung).

source.label: Source
source.plain: Where the person came from (UTM source like meta, google, or direct).
